name: Busa Messenger
description: Unified chat inbox: WhatsApp/Discord/Slack/Telegram accounts, conversations, messages, and a reply outbox

agentPrompts.label: What needs my attention?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-messenger` skill in this folder, then give me the messaging command-desk view — conversations needing a reply decision, approved replies waiting to send, anything blocked, and the oldest-waiting conversation.

agentPrompts.label: Sync my connected accounts
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-messenger` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then sync the configured accounts and report any connector problems as warnings, not silent failures.

agentPrompts.label: Draft replies for what's waiting
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-messenger` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then go through the conversations awaiting a reply and queue a drafted reply for each, honoring the configured reply style, for me to review in the outbox.

agentPrompts.label: Send the approved replies
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-messenger` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then show me the send plan for approved replies first; only send after I explicitly confirm, and report the per-reply result.
